methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 10 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Prusa Research is a bootstrapped robotics and manufacturing company founded by Josef Průša. The valuation universe comprises 9 peers across robotics and manufacturing: 1 public company (277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable to this analysis. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains 10 same-sector comparables, but filtering by stage, proximity, and valuation tier yields fewer than three datapoints in any single cohort. Reliance on an all-sector median would obscure meaningful distinctions in capital structure, operational maturity, and market positioning. No triangulated valuation estimate can be supported by the available comparable data.

The primary constraint is the absence of sufficiently granular peer clustering. While the broader peer set exists, the absence of same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables at similar valuation tiers prevents application of standard multiples-based approaches. Any valuation of Prusa Research at this stage would require either (1) expansion of the comparable set through primary diligence on founders and investors, (2) application of alternative methods (discounted cash flow or precedent transactions), or (3) reliance on qualitative assessments of competitive positioning relative to named peers. The bootstrapped capital structure further distinguishes Prusa from venture-backed comparables and limits direct financial benchmarking.
